austraits — agent & contributor guide

Source: AGENTS.md

austraits is the R interface to AusTraits, the Australian plant trait database: a thin AusTraits-specific layer over traits.use, which holds the generic code for any traits.build database (split out in 2026, austraits#188).

Repo-local guidance

  • Code: R/load_austraits.R (load_austraits(), get_versions(), get_version_latest(): version lookup on Zenodo, then traits.use::load_database()), R/plot_locations.R (wraps traits.use::plot_locations() with the map of Australia, australia_map_raster in R/sysdata.rda), R/reexports.R (re-exports every other traits.use export).
  • Generic code belongs in traits.use, not here. Fix bugs in extract_*(), join_*() etc. there. tests/testthat/test-reexports.R checks austraits re-exports every traits.use export; add new traits.use exports to R/reexports.R.
  • Build/test (standard R-package workflow): devtools::load_all(), devtools::test(), devtools::check(). The package targets R >= 4.1.0. Lifecycle badge is stable.
  • Default branch: master. Docs/pkgdown site at https://traitecoevo.github.io/austraits/.

traits.build no longer installs austraits: it depends on traits.use since traits.build#321 (2026-11-15). Before deleting any branch here, search the family for Remotes: pins to it: a pin to source-references-296 broke traits.build and austraits.build CI on 2026-11-14.

Heads-up: from Sept 2024 austraits works against any traits.build database (not just austraits.build). austraits.build versions < 5.0 are unsupported by the current package — older builds need an older tagged austraits (e.g. @v2.2.2).

AusTraits family — cross-package context

austraits is part of the AusTraits family (a subset of the traitecoevo org) — here, the AusTraits-specific R package over traits.use (the access/wrangle API for traits.build-format databases); loads the released .rds via load_austraits(). Family-wide concerns are documented centrally in austraits-meta — don’t restate them here, read them there:

  • Start with AGENTS.md — pipeline order, who owns what, dependency direction, source-of-truth rules, cross-boundary artifacts, gotchas.
  • dependencies.yml — machine-readable package graph + cross-boundary artifacts.
  • governance/ — label taxonomy, board #9 conventions, release playbooks, triage.

Filing issues: the whole family is tracked on one board, AusTraits #9 (new issues auto-add to it). Follow the issue & labelling guide: pick one work-type label (bug / task / epic); Status and Priority are set on the board, not as labels.

Commit messages: every family repo squash-merges, so the PR title and body become the permanent commit message. Keep the subject ≤50 characters as typed and the body ≤10 lines; put the working detail — what you tried, benchmarks, test counts, rejected alternatives — in the first PR comment instead. Full convention: commit-messages.md.

austraits-meta is hand-maintained prose — a map, not ground truth. Verify specifics against the actual repos.
